question: I recently read in a security blog: "The attackers sent emails containing exploit urls to their targets. If a target clicked the link during a logged-in Zimbra session, the url loaded the same framework that Volexity documented in February 2022." Please identify: 1) What is the MITRE ATT&CK category associated with this behavior? 2) Explain how the described behavior maps to that MITRE technique. 3) Which platform(s) are applicable for this technique (as specified in x_mitre_platforms)?
answer:
1) MITRE ATT&CK Category: Spearphishing Link (T1566.002).  
2) Mapping Explanation: The behavior describes attackers sending targeted emails that contain malicious/exploit URLs and relying on the recipient to click the link. This matches T1566.002, which covers spearphishing via embedded links that direct victims to attacker-controlled or exploit content to enable follow-on compromise.  
3) Applicable Platforms: Windows, macOS, Linux.
